originalWorkflow:
name: CI

# NOTE: This workflow builds/tests with dummy env vars.
# It catches compile errors, unit-test failures, and type regressions.
# It does NOT exercise the real Vercel runtime or real backend services.
#
# For PRs targeting main, a SEPARATE required check runs:
#   .github/workflows/preview-smoke.yml  — "Smoke test Vercel preview"
# That workflow waits for the Vercel preview deployment and hits
# /api/health + homepage against real env vars, catching runtime failures
# that dummy-key builds cannot detect (see incident: Next.js 16.2.1).
# The health probe fails on non-200 or JSON status != "healthy".
#
# DO-H1: Direct `develop` pushes do NOT get an equivalent runtime smoke
# check. `vercel.json`'s ignoreCommand skips the Vercel build for every
# non-production deploy with no PR id — i.e. every direct `develop` push —
# so no preview deployment is ever created for these commits. A prior
# develop-push smoke job (DO-M5) waited up to 5 minutes for a preview that
# could never appear, then reported SUCCESS via its timeout branch without
# having probed anything. It was removed rather than fixed to fail-on-
# timeout, since deleting it also reclaims the ~5.3 min of runner time it
# burned on every push for zero signal. Runtime regressions on `develop`
# commits are now only caught when a PR from `develop` to `main` runs
# `preview-smoke.yml` ("Smoke test Vercel preview"), which has a real
# preview to probe. See docs/operations/alerting-runbook.md.

on:
  push:
    branches: [develop, main]
    # DO-M7 (#834): skip the full lint/test/build suite for commits that
    # touch only prose. Filters the `push` trigger ONLY — `pull_request`
    # below stays unfiltered because "Lint & Typecheck", "Test", and
    # "Build" are required status checks for the `main` branch protection
    # rule. Filtering pull_request too could leave a docs-only release PR
    # waiting forever on a required context that never runs. See
    # e2e.yml/lighthouse.yml for the same convention.
    paths-ignore:
      - "docs/**"
      - "README.md"
      - "CHANGELOG.md"
      - "ROADMAP.md"
      - "AGENTS.md"
  pull_request:
    branches: [develop, main]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  develop_push_source:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      checks: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/validate-merged-pr.yml
    with:
      required_checks: '["Lint & Typecheck","Test","Build"]'

  lint-and-typecheck:
    name: Lint & Typecheck
    needs: develop_push_source
    if: always() && needs.develop_push_source.outputs.validated_by_pr != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install canvas system dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/install-canvas-deps

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Check verification coverage wiring
        run: npm run check-verification-coverage

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Check env vars documented
        run: npm run check-env

      - name: Validate migrations
        run: npm run check-migrations

      - name: Check circular dependencies
        run: npm run lint:deps

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Test suite runs ONCE, sharded across 4 runners for wall-clock speed.
  #
  # WHY: Previously two jobs ran the same ~400-file suite end-to-end — a
  # `test` job (`vitest run`) AND a `coverage` job (`vitest run --coverage`),
  # each ~8-9 min. That double-ran the suite and burned a full extra runner
  # per CI run for zero added signal (if coverage passes, the tests passed).
  #
  # NOW: a single sharded coverage suite. Each shard runs a quarter of the
  # suite with coverage instrumentation and emits a blob report. Per-shard
  # coverage thresholds are forced to 0 (a shard only sees 1/4 of the files,
  # so its partial coverage is meaningless); the REAL thresholds are enforced
  # exactly once on the merged total in `coverage-merge`. This preserves the
  # exact coverage gate while cutting the critical-path long pole ~9m -> ~4m.
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  coverage-shard:
    name: Coverage (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    needs: develop_push_source
    if: always() && needs.develop_push_source.outputs.validated_by_pr != 'true'
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, cirujano-baseline-actions_linux]
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      # Don't cancel sibling shards when one fails — we want the full picture.
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install canvas system dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/install-canvas-deps

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # No positional path arg: vitest.config.ts's `include` already scopes
      # both src/** and scripts/** test files; a positional would override it.
      # --reporter=blob writes .vitest/blob/blob-<shard>-4.json (vitest 5 default; vitest 4 used a
      # different directory) and --merge-reports reads the same directory by default.
      - name: Run tests with coverage (sharded)
        run: >-
          npx vitest run
          --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/4
          --coverage
          --reporter=blob
          --coverage.thresholds.lines=0
          --coverage.thresholds.functions=0
          --coverage.thresholds.statements=0
          --coverage.thresholds.branches=0

      - name: Upload coverage blob
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: coverage-blob-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: .vitest/blob/*
          include-hidden-files: true
          # A missing blob must fail the shard, not warn: the merge job would
          # otherwise fail later with an opaque ENOENT on the blob directory.
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  coverage-merge:
    name: Coverage merge
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    needs: coverage-shard
    # An explicit condition is required because coverage-shard itself depends
    # on develop_push_source. That source-validation job is intentionally
    # skipped on PRs, and GitHub's implicit success() would otherwise skip this
    # job even after all four matrix shards succeeded.
    if: ${{ always() && needs.coverage-shard.result == 'success' }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Download coverage blobs
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          pattern: coverage-blob-*
          path: .vitest/blob
          merge-multiple: true

      # --merge-reports combines the shard blobs and reports/enforces the REAL
      # coverage thresholds from vitest.config.ts once, on the combined total.
      - name: Merge reports and enforce coverage thresholds
        run: npx vitest run --merge-reports --coverage

  # Thin aggregator that PRESERVES the `Test` required status check on main.
  # `main` branch protection requires a check literally named "Test"; deleting
  # the old `test` job would block every develop->main release PR. This gate
  # reports green iff the sharded suite + merged coverage gate passed.
  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    needs: [develop_push_source, coverage-shard, coverage-merge]
    if: always()

    steps:
      - name: Verify test/coverage suite succeeded
        run: |
          if [ "${{ needs.develop_push_source.outputs.validated_by_pr }}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "Exact merge SHA already passed every required PR check."
            exit 0
          fi
          shards='${{ needs.coverage-shard.result }}'
          merge='${{ needs.coverage-merge.result }}'
          echo "coverage-shard=$shards coverage-merge=$merge"
          if [ "$shards" != "success" ] || [ "$merge" != "success" ]; then
            echo "::error::Test suite failed (shards=$shards, merge=$merge)"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Test suite passed (sharded) and coverage thresholds met."

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: develop_push_source
    if: always() && needs.develop_push_source.outputs.validated_by_pr != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install canvas system dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/install-canvas-deps

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build
        env:
          # Dummy values for build (APIs not called during build)
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: dummy_key_for_build
          VOYAGE_API_KEY: dummy_key_for_build
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: https://example.supabase.co
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: dummy_key_for_build
